Standing to his right are two companions: a man in a black floral short-sleeved shirt and a woman in a vibrant yellow sleeveless top and matching long skirt. The background features pink banners with the stylized white text '明星鍵盤手'. (2) The scene shifts between medium shots of the trio and close-up views of the man at the desk. The man in the floral shirt uses a thin black pointer to gesture toward the screen on the desk while the woman in yellow watches with an expectant smile. The man in grey interacts with the mixer, occasionally looking up to speak to his companions with a playful facial expression. Yellow and white text boxes with song information are briefly visible on the screen interface. (3) The energy levels spike as the woman in yellow suddenly bursts into high-energy movement, raising her right arm high and opening her mouth wide in a shout or song. The man in the floral shirt reacts by jumping and pointing excitedly, while the man in the grey shirt laughs and leans into the microphone. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout, emphasizing the vibrant colors of the set and clothing.
